# Datasets

This page catalogs all public datasets and proprietary extracts we will use throughout the semester.

## Publicly Available Datasets

| Dataset Name | Source | Format |
|--------------|--------|--------|
| **Opportunity Atlas** | [Opportunity Insights](https://www.opportunityinsights.org/data/) | CSV / Tract-level |
| **HOLC "Redlining" Maps** | [Mapping Inequality](https://dsl.richmond.edu/panorama/redlining/) | Shapefiles |
| **PLACES: Local Data for Better Health** | [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/places/) | CSV / Tract-level |
| **Social Vulnerability Index (SVI)** | [CDC ATSDR](https://www.atsdr.cdc.gov/placeandhealth/svi/) | CSV / Shapefile |
| **EJScreen Environmental Justice Tool** | [EPA](https://www.epa.gov/ejscreen) | CSV / Geodatabase |
| **Chicago Violence Reduction** | [Chicago Data Portal](https://data.cityofchicago.org/) | CSV / Point data |
| **NEISS IPV Narrative Subset** | [CPSC NEISS](https://www.cpsc.gov/Research--Statistics/NEISS-Injury-Data) | Text / CSV |
| **Ohio MOUD Providers** | [SAMHSA](https://www.samhsa.gov/medications-substance-use-disorders) | CSV / Spatial |
| **Boston Neighborhood Survey (BNS)** | [BNS Data](https://www.icpsr.umich.edu/) | Longitudinal CSV |
